{{DL|Nacrene City|Nacrene Museum}} }} '''Mine Mayhem''' (Japanese: '''VS ドリュウズ''' ''VS Excadrill''), titled '''VS Excadrill''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 492nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 32nd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. It is subtitled '''Excadrill''' (Japanese: '''出土''' ''Excavation'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Mine Mayhem''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Black}} arrives at the [[Driftveil Gym]]. * Black tries to get his {{p|Tirtouga}} to listen to him. * After learning that Tirtouga evolves into {{p|Carracosta}}, Black names his Tirtouga "[[Costa]]". * Black begins his Gym battle against Clay. * [[Chili]], [[Cress]], and [[Cilan]] prepare to head to [[Nacrene City]]. * Lenora wonders why the people spying on her haven't acted yet. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Black}} * [[Cilan]] * [[Chili]] * [[Cress]] * [[Lenora]] * [[Clay]] * [[Hawes]] (flashback) * [[Bronius]] (flashback) * {{tc|Worker}} Felix * {{tc|Worker}} Rich * {{tc|Worker}} Sterling * {{tc|Worker}} Don * {{tc|Worker}} Heath * {{tc|Worker}}s * {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munna}} ([[Musha]]; {{adv|Black}}'s) * {{p|Pignite}} ([[Bo|Nite]]; {{adv|Black}}'s) * {{p|Galvantula}} ([[Tula]]; {{adv|Black}}'s) * {{p|Tirtouga}} ([[Costa]]; {{adv|Black}}'s) * {{p|Carracosta}} ([[Costa]]; {{adv|Black}}'s; fantasy) * {{p|Pansage}} ({{OP|Cilan|Pansage}}) * {{p|Pansear}} ({{OP|Chili|Pansear}}) * {{p|Panpour}} ({{OP|Cress|Panpour}}) * {{p|Stoutland}} ([[Lenora]]'s) * {{p|Patrat}} ([[Lenora]]'s) * {{p|Excadrill}} ({{OP|Clay|Excadrill}}) * {{p|Krokorok}} ([[Clay]]'s) * {{p|Palpitoad}} ([[Clay]]'s) * {{p|Woobat}} (multiple) * {{p|Zekrom}} ({{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom|Adventures}}; fantasy) ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|BW}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|BW}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 龍頭地鼠 - 出土|VS Excadrill - Unearthed}} |fr_eu={{tt|Duel au ras du sol !|Battle at Ground Level}} |de={{tt|VS.
